pages.title: The Realm of Direction
pages.body: Spells are ordered geometric programs. Begin at north on the outer ring, read clockwise, then move inward. A valid program reshapes the world; a broken one fails at the physical sigil that caused the fault.

pages.title: Persistent Magic
pages.body: Every continuing effect receives one versioned server ledger contract containing its owner, program hash, dimension, natural endpoint or hard deadline, exact prepaid upkeep, and bounded cleanup handles. Use /vectorregnum effect status to inspect your live contracts. Loaded effects reconcile exact upkeep installments. Offline owners cannot drive world mutations; unloaded chunks pause reconciliation until they load again. Restart recovery resumes from SavedData. Natural conclusions clean once. Exhausted upkeep or a missing conclusion becomes bounded deterministic Wild Magic, then cleans instead of remaining free or orphaned.

elements.label: Durable effect lifecycle
elements.alt: A cast transfers prepaid upkeep to a versioned ledger, reconciles while loaded, then reaches natural cleanup or bounded Wild Magic collapse.

elements.alt: The effect status command lists each short contract ID, state, handle count, remaining ticks, and upkeep balance.

pages.title: Finite Crystal Sources
pages.body: You begin with zero mana and zero capacity. Craft a source and shards. Constructed sources hold eight finite charges. Buried natural crystals mature and recharge only while loaded and supported by conductive geology; nearby natural sources slow one another.

pages.title: Storage and Conduits
pages.body: Route one loaded source through a matching conduit tier into persistent storage. Crystal Vials hold 200 μ through Raw Crystal Conduits (8 blocks, 25 μ/tick, 80% efficient). Runed Cells hold 1,000 μ through Runed Conduits (24 blocks, 100 μ/tick, 95%). Resonant Vaults hold 8,000 μ through Resonant Conduits (64 blocks, 400 μ/tick, lossless). Use a store for status; sneak-use to draw up to 100 μ. Retuning requires an empty, idle store.

pages.body: Use the circle commands to create, place, parameterize, remove, undo, show, compile, and cast. Press V in a connected world for the server-backed graphical editor; press K for the latest Ponder. Ring 0 is outermost. Slot 0 is north. Exact diagnostics retain both this physical coordinate and the lowered instruction pointer.

pages.title: Faults and Wild Magic
pages.body: Compiler faults stop invalid bytecode from being published. Runtime faults are bounded and preserve their source. Compatibility spell failures may detonate internally, burst as an unstructured element, or become a violent miscast according to the actual CastResult.

elements.label: Fault path
elements.alt: Compilation fault stops before execution; runtime fault fractures the currently executing sigil; compatibility faults may emit Wild Magic.

elements.label: Ponder the real fault
elements.alt: Display the diagnostic, VM fault, or Wild Magic category carried by the actual result.

pages.title: Shared Memory and Branches
pages.body: Advanced programs can store typed variables, iterate immutable lists one item per server tick, test bounded entity/point collisions, and publish watcher signals or owner-visible output. Logical FORK branches share the same Push/Pop stack and variable map. They advance in stable creation order on the authoritative server tick; shared operations are atomic and traced. JOIN waits for active children and CANCEL_BRANCH is idempotent. Work, lifetime, active and total branches, messages, iterator steps, and stack depth remain hard-capped. Active control state is ephemeral and never resumes after restart. Run /vectorregnum vm control_demo for the bounded teaching program.

elements.label: One tick, one shared order
elements.alt: The main path and logical child branches visit one shared stack and variable map in stable creation order, with hard caps around the runtime.

elements.alt: Follow authoritative variable, iterator, collision, signal, output, fork, join, and shared Push/Pop events in deterministic order.

elements.label: Run the bounded control demo

pages.title: Bounded Recovered Mechanics
pages.body: Recovered dangerous magic is explicit and bounded. Render-only cues never grant glowing or alter the world. Disruption requires a live spell, a crouching stance, an enchanted netherite sword, line of sight, and a four-block timing window. Forced attention is a short server-tick effect with a 32-block range, 45-degree cone, three-degree step, and a visible rune warning. Claims, dimensions, loaded chunks, PvP, teams, and target counts are checked before gameplay changes. Wild Magic carries a deterministic seed, a bounded envelope, and a cleanup deadline. Client reduced-motion, photosensitive, density, camera, and audio controls may remove expression but never the truth telegraph.

elements.label: Capability gates
elements.alt: A recovered mechanic passes through capability, lifecycle, permission, range, target, and deterministic-randomness gates before a bounded result.

pages.title: Natural Element and Attunement
pages.body: Every character carries exactly one permanent natural element. Your channel attunement is mutable and selects which source resonance you can draw efficiently; changing it never changes your natural identity. Arcane is neutral raw mana, Void is rare, and Ice is the cold resonance. Tune sources with prismarine crystals (Water), blaze powder (Fire), a feather (Air), a clay ball (Earth), a copper ingot (Lightning), a clock (Time), an ender pearl (Space), glowstone dust (Light), an ink sac (Dark), wheat seeds (Nature), a snowball (Ice), an echo shard (Sound), an ender eye (Void), or an amethyst shard (Arcane).

elements.label: Fourteen bounded resonances
elements.alt: A permanent natural element anchors a character while a separate channel attunement points toward a source.

elements.alt: Use the mana attune command to select a mutable channel resonance without replacing the natural element.

pages.title: Scroll, Book, and Tablet
pages.body: Choose one of six casting methods. BARE casts use no medium. RITUAL casts use a staged offering pool. ENGRAVING accepts construction materials into an anchored spell circle. SPELLBOOK is reusable portable media. SCROLL is committed at activation and burns on a successful cast or genuine spell fault. INSTALLED_CIRCLE is anchored and reusable. Success and genuine spell fault/Wild Magic consume escrow and scroll; policy, unloaded-target, rate, shutdown, and internal failures refund escrow or never withdraw it. Books and both anchored forms, an engraved spell circle and an installed circle, remain reusable. Engraving materials are committed at accepted binding with /vectorregnum circle bind engraving. Solo offerings use the circle ritual command; cooperative split and replicate rituals use the separate ritual command family.

pages.title: Quotes, reagents, and escrow
pages.body: The compiler shows the undiscounted quote, each reagent contribution, requested and applied discounts, clipping, and the final bounded quote before approval. Stage discount reagents with /vectorregnum reagents stage mana|casting_time|upkeep|instability <count>. Stage quartz separately with /vectorregnum reagents stage offering <count>; quartz=ritual_offering and grants no discount. Use /vectorregnum reagents clear to remove both pools. The discount mappings are amethyst_shard=mana, sugar=casting_time (casting time), glowstone_dust=upkeep, and fermented_spider_eye=instability. /vectorregnum circle quote <method> inspects BARE, RITUAL, ENGRAVING, SPELLBOOK, SCROLL, or INSTALLED_CIRCLE, while /vectorregnum circle ritual requires the staged solo offering. Bind accepted construction materials with /vectorregnum circle bind engraving. Escrow reserves resources before execution. Success and genuine spell fault/Wild Magic consume escrow and scroll. Policy, unloaded-target, rate, shutdown, owner-lifecycle, and internal failures refund or never withdraw it. A SPELLBOOK and both anchored forms remain reusable. Cooperative approval transfers each contributor's exact bounded commitment into a separate checksummed ritual escrow.

elements.label: Bounded resource quote
elements.alt: The server compares the undiscounted quote with reagent contributions, then clamps the final quote before reservation.

elements.label: Vanilla reagent mappings
elements.alt: Amethyst shard lowers mana, sugar lowers casting time, glowstone dust lowers upkeep, fermented spider eye lowers instability, and quartz is an offering-only ritual resource.

pages.title: Cooperative Rituals
pages.body: A leader creates SPLIT or REPLICATE from one frozen compiled circle with /vectorregnum ritual create <mode> <max_mana> <max_reagents> <max_upkeep>. Invite each named contributor with /vectorregnum ritual invite <id> <player> <max_mana> <max_reagents> <max_upkeep>. Those values are that contributor's exact maximum commitment for this ritual only. Each contributor stages their exact typed reagent loadout and explicitly runs /vectorregnum ritual approve <id>. Status lists the short ID, mode, state, terms, and reservation. Nothing starts until everyone approves. SPLIT combines the approved pool into one execution. REPLICATE launches one bounded copy per contributor in stable order. Approval is checksummed and retry-safe. A pre-start decline, disconnect, expiry, policy failure, invalid launch, or restart mismatch cancels and refunds every reservation exactly once. Use /vectorregnum ritual decline|cancel|start <id> and /vectorregnum ritual status.

elements.label: Consent and escrow lifecycle
elements.alt: Every contributor approves exact mana, reagent, and upkeep maxima before split or replicate execution; any pre-start failure refunds all reservations exactly once.

elements.alt: Create a split ritual with explicit maxima, invite a named contributor with their own exact maxima, stage each loadout, approve, inspect, and start.

pages.title: Five New Programs
pages.body: The library now contains 20 server-authoritative programs. Fireball detonates a bounded non-block-breaking impact, Storm Arc strikes at most six nearby hostiles, Tidal Prison slows at most six hostiles for six seconds, Stone Aegis raises an eight-second self barrier, and Teleport blinks to a loaded collision-free block face. Compile and mana costs come from each program's lowered vm2 instructions; use /vectorregnum library inspect <id> before casting.
